subject: English
stimulus: (a) No sooner had we reached the school ⎯⎯. (b) Unless you study attentively ⎯⎯. (c) Scarcely had the party begun ⎯⎯. (d) If 1 had known his mobile number ⎯⎯. (e) Work hard provided that ⎯⎯.
guide_solution: Completing sentences (a) No sooner had we reached the school than the bell rang. (b) Unless you study attentively you cannot pass the exam. (c) Scarcely had the party begun when we reached there. (d) If I had known his mobile number I would have called him. (e) Work hard provided that you want to succeed in life.
